story.title: The Backup Smile
story.logline: A socially anxious man buys a digital happiness implant, only to discover it refuses to turn off when his mother dies.
story.twist: The smile isn't reflecting his mood; it is slowly replacing his ability to feel anything else.
story.ending: Why am I crying tears of joy?

scenes.narration: My face broke when she told me the devastating news, but the implant instantly forced my lips into a wide grin.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, wearing a gray hoodie, inside a dimly lit cramped bedroom, crying while his mouth is forced into a bright, glossy smile. Vertical 9:16.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on the mouth and eyes

scenes.narration: The JoyNode was supposed to cure my social anxiety. Just a tiny chip behind the ear for permanent happiness.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, touching a glowing blue scar behind his ear in the same dimly lit bedroom. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: I tapped the emergency reset button frantically, begging the system to let me grieve my mother properly today.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, furiously tapping behind his ear in the dimly lit bedroom, teeth bared in a manic smile. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: A robotic chime echoed in my skull. Error code four hundred. Neural override engaged by corporate policy.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, staring wide-eyed at his phone screen reflecting a bright blue error message in the dark room. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: I ran out into the hallway, tears streaming down my cheeks while my mouth laughed hysterically at nothing.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, running down a narrow apartment hallway, weeping tears while laughing brightly. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: My neighbor peeked out of her doorway, whispering condolences while staring strangely at my glowing cheerful expression.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, standing in the apartment hallway facing an elderly neighbor who looks deeply disturbed. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: I tried to scream at her to help me, but the chip translated my terror into cheerful upbeat laughter.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, gripping his throat in the hallway, mouth wide open in a cheerful laugh while sobbing. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: She backed away slowly, whispering that I was a monster for smiling on the day my mother died.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, standing alone in the hallway as a neighbor closes her door in fear. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: I sat on the cold floor, completely paralyzed as the relentless synthetic joy bubbled up inside my chest.
scenes.visual_prompt: Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, sitting slumped on the hallway floor, tears pouring down a face locked in a radiant smile. Vertical 9:16.

scenes.narration: The app finally pinged with a cheerful update. Why am I crying tears of joy?
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close up of Leo, 25, messy brown hair, gray hoodie, smiling brightly into the camera while dark tears fall continuously. Vertical 9:16.

caption.hook: Forced to smile while his world ended.
caption.title: The Backup Smile
caption.caption:
He bought the implant to fake confidence, not realizing it would lock his face in joy while he buried his mother. Now, the happiness isn't just masking his grief—it's erasing it.

Is a synthetic smile better than real pain?
